transcript:
SOURCE: Fathom (via HubSpot internal notes) — https://fathom.video/share/M7kBcHpUNmgWPjgae8bUXEtcfCHozYRW

AI Meeting Summary ✨

Generated by Fathom // View Recording (77 mins - No highlights)

Meeting Purpose

To explore SMB Team's services for scaling the Velie law firm.

Key Takeaways

Strategic Growth: The Dallas office must be systematized to run independently before expanding to new markets (NY, SF), freeing CEO Jon Velie from daily litigation to focus on strategy.

Profitability First: A key goal is increasing firm-wide profitability to 20–30% from its current unknown, low margin. This requires better financial tracking and client selection.

Intake is the Bottleneck: The Dallas office's informal intake process is a major weakness, causing missed opportunities and poor client selection. Replicating the OK office's successful, tech-driven intake is critical.

SMB Team's Proposed Solution: A phased plan using fractional support (COO for systems, CTO for automation) to build a scalable foundation, with services priced from ~$3.5k–$10k/month.

Topics

The Firm's Challenge: Unprofitable Growth

Structure: Two distinct law offices:

Oklahoma (OK): Immigration law, with a tech-driven intake process.

Dallas (TX): Full-service litigation (business, PI), operating on referrals with no formal marketing.

Core Problem: Growth has outpaced systems, creating an unsustainable model.

Jon Velie (CEO): Overwhelmed by daily practice, preventing focus on executive strategy.

Pam Velie (CGO): Hired to audit operations and build a scalable foundation.

Financials:

Revenue: ~$2.5M projected for 2026.

Profitability: Unknown but low; the 12-month goal is 20–30%.

Dallas Office: $700k revenue in 2025; goal of $1M–$1.5M for 2026.

The Solution: Systematize Dallas Intake & Operations

OK Office Intake: A successful, tech-driven system using visas.ai for strategy, immediate contract generation, and a dedicated closer.

Dallas Office Intake: An informal, attorney-led process with no documented follow-up, leading to:

Missed Opportunities: No system to capture and convert leads.

Poor Client Selection: Taking on unprofitable cases that run out of funds.

Strategic Goal: Replicate the OK office's systematic intake in Dallas to attract high-value clients (e.g., PI for the local South Asian community) and improve profitability.

SMB Team's Proposed Services

Fractional COO: To build and implement operational systems, freeing Jon Velie from daily practice.

Fractional CTO: To integrate the tech stack (Clio, QuickBooks, Stripe) and build custom automations.

Rationale: This solves the current lack of integration, which would cost $8,400/year for a single Clio feature.

AI Workforce Pro: A law firm-specific LLM with pre-built skills for intake, billing, and client experience.

Marketing: A future consideration for targeted campaigns once internal systems are solid.

Next Steps

Jacob Meissner:

Send a meeting recap and e-book.

Prepare a tailored recommendation for the follow-up meeting.

Jon & Pam Velie:

Attend the follow-up meeting to review the recommendation.

All:

Meet on Friday, August 21st, at 3:00 PM Central to discuss the proposal.

Action Items

Consult team re: Dallas-first blueprint; prepare tailored recs for Jon & Pam - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Jon & Pam recap email w/ AI seminar link + book options; request preference - WATCH (5 secs)
Send Jon & Pam calendar invite for follow-up Fri 3 pm CT; request confirmation - WATCH (5 secs)
